channel.title: George | Christian Essays
channel.description: Short, honest Christian essays on faith, work, and ordinary life.

item.title: Busy Isn't Faithful
item.description: Martha was serving, but Jesus named the anxiety beneath her motion. Discover why frantic Christian busyness is not devotion and how to embrace true rest.

item.title: Nobody Is Self-Made
item.description: Hands can bleed with honest effort and still stand on borrowed ground. An honest Christian reflection on Deuteronomy, humility, and the quiet gift of grace.

item.title: Churches Don't Drift Toward Truth
item.description: Theological drift is quiet, gradual, and always away from Christ. Explore how congregations lose their anchor and why guarding biblical truth demands resolve.

item.title: Faithfulness Can Feel Lonely
item.description: There is a quiet ache in staying true when culture walks away. Discover biblical encouragement for the isolation that often accompanies Christian integrity.

item.title: God Doesn't Need Your Resume
item.description: Moses had a stutter, Gideon was hiding, and Peter denied Christ. A reflection on how God qualifies the called instead of demanding impressive credentials.

item.title: Terrified of Silence
item.description: We fill our days with noise because stillness forces us to confront who we are. An honest reflection on recovering quiet solitude and intimacy with God.

item.title: The Bible Was Never About You
item.description: We often read Scripture like a self-help manual rather than the story of redemption. Discover how shifting the focus back to Jesus transforms how you read.

item.title: The Jesus You Missed in the Old Testament
item.description: The Old Testament is rich with shadows, types, and promises fulfilled in Christ. Trace the redemptive threads from Genesis through the prophets in this essay.

item.title: The Respectable Sin Nobody Talks About
item.description: We condemn outward vices while treating chronic worry as harmless. Explore why anxiety is a theological statement and how Romans 8 offers profound peace.

item.title: The Verse That Is Slowly Killing You
item.description: Jeremiah 29:11 is printed on coffee mugs, yet rarely read in context. Unpack what God actually promised exiles in Babylon and why real hope is far deeper.

item.title: You Were Not Made for Sadness
item.description: Grief and brokenness are intruders in God's good creation. A compassionate Christian reflection on enduring sorrow with the sure hope of resurrection joy.

item.title: Waiting Is Not Wasting
item.description: From Abraham to David, God used prolonged waiting seasons to forge character. Discover why waiting is never wasted time when God is the one doing the work.

item.title: What Poverty Taught Me About Riches
item.description: Material abundance often masks spiritual impoverishment. A heartfelt reflection on Christian stewardship, gratitude, and true treasure in the kingdom.

item.title: Whatever You Do, As Unto the Lord
item.description: Colossians 3 transforms mundane tasks into acts of worship. Explore how everyday labor, quiet chores, and unseen faithfulness become holy offerings to God.

item.title: Why Friendship Feels So Rare
item.description: Modern busyness has reduced deep covenant bonds to superficial digital interactions. Discover why biblical fellowship requires vulnerability and time.

item.title: Work Existed Before Sin
item.description: Work was instituted in the Garden of Eden before the Fall, not as a curse. Rediscover God's original design for meaningful daily labor, vocation, and rest.

item.title: You Are Not Your Job Title
item.description: When career titles collapse, what remains of your worth? A quiet meditation on untangling professional identity from who you truly are in the eyes of God.

item.title: Your Mind Is Under Attack
item.description: The modern siege on faith is waged through constant digital distraction. Learn how the attention economy fragments the soul and how to guard your mind today.
